rows.market_wrap: Nifty rose 1.12% to 25,801 and the Sensex gained about 898 points for a second straight up day, led by private and PSU banks as foreign funds turned buyers; India held up while Asian markets slumped on a global sell-off in AI stocks, helped by softer crude. Breadth was weak, though: the Nifty Smallcap 100 slipped 0.13%. Your portfolio fell 0.47% (about ₹2,773): stocks and ETFs lost 2.7% as gold and silver crashed again on US rate-hike bets, while funds were roughly flat. AMFI had not published 20 November NAVs by 10 PM IST, so fund values reflect 19 November NAVs, where silver fund-of-funds fell about 2% and equity funds rose.
